title: Little girl drawing with her father in front
notes: Over the father's shoulder (his patterned shirt fills the right ~40% of frame, soft focus, back of head only): a girl (~7) at a kitchen table draws in a booklet with an orange felt pen, then at ~5.0 s stops, lifts the booklet up to look at it and fiddles with it/the stickers instead of drawing until the end. Literal 'the A-group children spent less time drawing': she draws during the 2 centre lines (1.0-4.5 s) and quits drawing just as the bottom lines start; the adult watching from the foreground echoes P52's observer. BRIGHT daylight kitchen (white walls, steel fridge): darken/desaturate a lot. The child's face is visible (she is a study child, not the protagonist). The booklet is a brick-toy instruction booklet she drew on (no legible logo; its QR-code back flips past motion-blurred ~9.5 s); the pens' print and the fridge's dispenser label are out of focus/unreadable. blur_box = a laptop screen peeking out behind the father's shoulder (tiny green WhatsApp-style icon + UI, visible for the whole span). One continuous take, 11.9 s; I avoided 43352 (same girl, close-up) because its pens carry clearly legible 'BIC Kid COULEUR' print.

title: A girl's hands embellishing a Valentine's Day card
notes: Close-up of a girl's hands (pink heart-pattern sweater, long curly hair; face cut off at the chin) steadily drawing small hearts with a plain pink felt pen on a white card, absorbed, from 0.9 to 11.9 s without stopping: literal 'B group showed no such decrease' (she keeps drawing). A different child from st18. Valentine's craft table (red/pink paper hearts, twine, a jar of skewers): medium-bright and saturated pink/red, so desaturate/darken. The pen has no visible print. blur_box = a red card at the left edge printed with fragments of large decorative letters (drifts up/left during the take; the box covers it 1.5-7.7 s). One take, 14.6 s. Alt 4598 is downloaded (full/4598.mp4, in 8.0): a different girl lying on a rug in a DIM living room, bent over a notebook with a pen for 7-20 s; it matches the dark look but reads more like homework than drawing.

title: Young father working alongside his daughter
notes: Over the shoulder of a girl (ponytail, back to camera) at a dining table: her father, working at a laptop, looks up as she raises a picture book/page to him (~8.9 s); at ~12.5 s he reacts with wide-eyed, delighted praise, laughs (13.7 s), she holds up a second page (~15 s), he smiles (17-18.7 s). Under the full centre-subtitle blur it reads as 'a child shows her work, the adult heaps on the reaction', i.e. an external reward added to a liked activity. COMPROMISE: there is no Free reward-object clip (trophy/medal/award/certificate/gold-star/sticker clips 45912, 22505, 21791, 21792, 45913, 45907, 21922, 39520, 36429, 17993, 19665, 30884, 26784, 26787, 18032, 48123, 46416, 30880, 19601, 13320 (teacher praises student), 11447, 6319, 24689, 47017, 47013, 46972, 14006 are all Restricted; 18305 banknotes is Free but shows legible '100' notes). What she holds is actually a printed picture book with a tree on it (text not legible, and blurred anyway). BRIGHT daylight window; the father's face is visible (parent figure, not the protagonist). Same family/shoot as st18 (same father's shirt), so st18 -> st19 reads as one household. blur_box = Apple logo on the gold laptop lid (static). One take, 19.0 s. Alt 52233 (Free): mother and daughter hi-five while colouring, but only 8.2 s.

title: Painter's Hand Softly Brushing a Canvas
notes: Close-up of a painter's brush laying soft yellow highlights on a still-life canvas (white jug, drapery, blue tape border) in a warm, softly lit studio: the slow process of painting. The brush leaves frame ~5.6-8.5 s (canvas only) and returns with the hand and a tattooed forearm at ~8.8 s. No face, no text. Warm and medium-dim (curtained window at right); all centre-blurred, so it just needs to read as 'someone painting'. Pairs with st21: the same studio and still life shown finished and alone. 1080p: the tool's default URL only gave 720p for this new-style id, so I fetched the active_storage '...-video-1080.mp4' (via mk.fetch with the shared lock) and replaced the 720p file. One take, 11.4 s (use runs to 11.3).

title: Finished Still Life Painting on an Easel
notes: Slow dolly across a DIM vintage art studio: a finished still-life painting stands alone on an easel beside the real fruit bowl and gold drapery it depicts, brushes in a jar, nobody in the room: literal 'a day when nobody looks at it', and it pays off st20 (same studio/painting). Dim, warm, cinematic; usable almost as is. No text (the small bottle at the bottom edge is out of focus). 1080p fetched from active_storage like st20. One take, 9.0 s (usable to ~8.5 s). Note: group E uses 100473 (same studio) for st45, about 5 minutes later.

title: Drunk young man watching television
notes: A bearded man in a plaid shirt on a sofa points a TV remote (2-6.5 s), sits idle, then rubs his forehead and props his head on his hand (8.8-11.7 s): free time, but nothing seems fun (flipping channels, bored). Brown beer bottles (no labels) in the soft-focus foreground (the title says 'drunk'). His face is visible, but the whole segment is centre-blurred. Daylight living room, grey/desaturated, medium brightness: darken a little. The white remote has no readable mark. One take, 12.9 s.

title: A person turning up the volume on the TV
notes: Close-up of a hand holding a black TV remote and pressing buttons (channel surfing) against a soft-focus living-room background (a person's jeans, a soccer ball, couch): passive leisure, free time without absorption. Hands only. Bright daylight colours: darken/desaturate (all centre-blurred). blur_box = the red NETFLIX button on the remote (moves with the hand, often under the thumb; the box covers it 1.6-8.4 s). The number keys and small 'CH/PAGE' labels are generic and unreadable once blurred. The hand enters at 1.4 s and leaves at ~9 s. One take, 10.2 s. Alt 26089 (Free, man watching TV with fast food, dim) is the same actor/sofa as ep3's 26091/26092, so I avoided it.

title: Wood lathe in action
notes: Close-up of weathered hands guiding a chisel on a spinning wood lathe; fine wood dust in warm backlight: someone absorbed in a hands-on craft (woodworking). No face, no text (the blue lathe body shows no brand in frame). Warm, medium-dim, cinematic. The hands lift away after ~11 s. One take, 14.0 s. Chosen instead of a jigsaw so the puzzle visual can carry st28. Alt 5329 (Free): hands assembling a purple jigsaw on a dark wood table, very moody, 10.7 s.

title: Young man browsing the Internet with a tablet
notes: Rear three-quarter, over-the-shoulder view of a bearded man with round glasses (afro hair, mustard collar; face mostly hidden, clearly a different person, no protagonist look-alike) scrolling a grid of picture thumbnails on a tablet (0.3-4 s), opening an article (~4.3 s) and then a large photo (from ~6 s): 'picking in your head'. Warm, dim interior. The screen is out of focus: headline and UI not legible; dock icons are tiny coloured dots. CAVEAT: it is a news site, and the big photo (~6-10 s) is a busy, blurry crowd/interior scene; it only appears during the 3 centre (blurred) lines, while the 3 bottom lines cover the thumbnail-grid part. Not ideal; I had no spare download left to swap it. Better-fit Free options, not downloaded: 50764 (a man takes his laptop and sits on the couch; not checked visually) or 41204 (same tablet series, hand with stylus). One take, 13.9 s.

title: Focus on the hand of an artist girl painting with watercolor
notes: Over a woman's shoulder (curly hair soft-focus at left; her face is never shown): her hand paints a pencil-sketched face with a fine brush in purple/blue watercolour; a palette with blue and purple paint slides into view from ~4 s. Warm, low, lamp-like light, dim: it continues P64-P66 (fine brush, blue palette, lamp light) and sets up st30's 'drawing a face exactly was frustrating'. The hand is a woman's, but it is hands-only framing. blur_box = two paint tubes at the top edge with barcodes and small print (not legible, but packaging); they are in frame only until ~8.0 s. The brush handle carries a tiny barcode/digits (not legible at normal size). One take, 15.0 s. Note: group E's st43 (41602) is from the same watercolour session.

title: A person sowing a seed
notes: Low close-up in a garden bed at golden hour: a slim hand drops a seed into a freshly dug hole (~10.5 s), the hoe pulls back, then the hand slowly pats soil over it (15.8-26.5 s); a small seedling stands in the soft-focus background with warm sun flare. Calm and slow: a planted interest that grows with care, matching 'grew their liking by doing it again'. No face, no text. Medium-bright golden backlight: darken/desaturate (all centre-blurred). One take, 28.1 s, so no speed change needed. Note the plant motif repeats (part 1 st07 watering 4776; group E st51b uses 1780, watering a pot). Free sketchbook-flipping clips do not exist (47164, 13328 Restricted; 50732 'art book' shows legible text and nudes), and the sprout/germination time-lapses are Restricted (46091, 45360, 47540, 14879-14884, 9762, 17751, 38373). Alt 4483 (Free): ranunculus opening on a dark background, but the hue cycles through colours, and part 1 already used opening lilies.

title: Hands of a girl putting together the edge of a puzzle
notes: Top-down: hands pick up a jigsaw piece (7.0-8.0 s), turn it over and around to find the fit (8.5-10.5 s), then press it into the edge strip (11-12 s): 'it didn't fit (맞지 않는다) at first, turn it and it fits'. Hands only, warm wood table, medium-bright (darken a bit). No text. One take, 19.0 s. Same puzzle shoot as ep3's 42188 (that was the woman's frontal shot; this is a hands-only shot). The literal options were unavailable: erasing/crumpled-sketch clips are Restricted or taken (39846 crumpled-paper bin = group D st33), all knitting/crochet clips are Restricted (7125, 7169, 10131, 7117, 36540, 47072-47075, 47197, 47198), and group D uses most of the Free guitar clips.

title: Guy texting at sunset
notes: Low-angle close-up of a man's hand (hairy forearm, denim shirt; beard only at the frame edge, no face) holding a smartphone up against the low sun, with lens flares and city rooftops below: the phone you already use plus beautiful evening light. The phone is edge-on/at an angle: no logo, and the screen is not readable. BRIGHT golden backlight: darken a little. The title says 'texting', but in this span he holds the phone up into the light, so it reads as capturing it. Every real phone-photography clip was Restricted (18022, 6555, 33471, 27475, 12991, 35803, 24335, 13291, 9062, 8951); the Free food-photo ones show camera UI. One take, 17.9 s. Alt 4808 (Free): a man silhouetted against a sunset, looking at his phone.

title: Painting a picture with a palette knife
notes: Close-up of a palette knife spreading light-blue paint over turquoise, next to loose orange and magenta strokes on canvas: free, abstract colour painting (no faces, just colour). Only a fingertip at the bottom edge; no text. Bright and saturated (not dim): desaturate/darken slightly. A clearly different clip and medium from st26 (watercolour face). Same artist session as ep3's 43444, but a different canvas, so not a visual repeat. One take, 16.1 s.
